card.title: Lost in the Process
card.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dispatch handed it to transport without a receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

beats.text: Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dispatch handed it to transport without a receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

mechanism: A disperses a personally lost parcel into separate departmental failures even when B identifies all roles as A.
confusable: Unlike a single excuse blaming another person, A must fragment causation across process labels.
comparison: Dispatch/transport/receipt control multiply one actor; invitation address error becomes an archive staffing issue.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
